in_marathi.name: Prutha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dwelling, Residence, Abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prutha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Prutha means 'Dwelling, Residence, Abode'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prutha', which refers to a dwelling, a residence, or an abode. This name is often associated with the goddess Prutha, who is believed to protect and nurture those who seek her shelter. Prutha is also a name of the wife of the sage Vishwamitra in Hindu mythology. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl.
